description: This file defines a centralized state management store using Zustand for a gym management system frontend. It manages collections for classes, bookings, memberships, and selected entity details, providing fetch, create, update, delete, and selection functions.

methods.name: fetchClasses
methods.description: Fetches the list of classes from the API and updates the store.

methods.name: createClass
methods.description: Creates a new class via the API and adds it to the store.

methods.name: updateClass
methods.description: Updates an existing class identified by id through the API and updates the store.

methods.name: deleteClass
methods.description: Deletes a class by id via the API and removes it from the store.

methods.name: fetchBookings
methods.description: Fetches the list of bookings from the API and updates the store.

methods.name: createBooking
methods.description: Creates a new booking via the API and adds it to the store.

methods.name: updateBooking
methods.description: Updates a booking identified by id through the API and updates the store.

methods.name: deleteBooking
methods.description: Deletes a booking by id via the API and updates the store.

methods.name: fetchMemberships
methods.description: Fetches the list of memberships from the API and updates the store.

methods.name: createMembership
methods.description: Creates a new membership via the API and adds it to the store.

methods.name: updateMembership
methods.description: Updates a membership identified by id through the API and updates the store.

methods.name: deleteMembership
methods.description: Deletes a membership by id via the API and updates the store.

methods.name: selectEntity
methods.description: Selects an entity (class, booking, or membership) by fetching its details.
